[[File:ReviveTicket.png|150px|thumb]]
==Description==
'''Revive''' is a mechanic that allows the players to save a lost match, giving them another chance at beating it.

When activated, the match will be reverted back to state it was in on the last completed wave. Players will be given as much time as they want to prepare and can start the match by pressing the ready button.

==Tickets==
{{ReviveTicket|Revive Tickets}} are a currency that can be used only when losing a match. These can be gained from triumphs, [[Login Rewards]], [[Spin Wheel]] with a 28.57% chance, or three can be bought for {{Robux|29}}. It takes the appearance of a blue ticket with white wings on it.
